headlines.description: — Kevin McGonigle drove in three runs, Drew Anderson tossed four innings of one-run ball in his fourth start of the year, and the Detroit Tigers beat the Cleveland Guardians 6-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McGonigle drives in three to lead Tigers past Guardians 6-4

headlines.description: — Eury Pérez allowed three hits over seven innings, Esteury Ruiz homered and the Miami Marlins beat Paul Skenes and the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eury Pérez outpitches Paul Skenes and Esteury Ruiz homers as the Marlins beat the Pirates 2-0

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong, Alex Bregman and Seiya Suzuki homered, and the Chicago Cubs rallied from an early deficit to beat the Washington Nationals 8-6 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits 27th homer and Cubs beat Nationals 8-6 to move 20 games over .500

events.name: Seattle Mariners at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Ryan McMahon and Trent Grisham each hit a two-run single in the seventh inning to send the New York Yankees past the slumping Seattle Mariners 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan McMahon and Trent Grisham deliver clutch hits for Yankees in 4-1 win over slumping Mariners

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Ernie Clement drove in the tiebreaking run in the sixth inning, Brett Bateman had two RBI and the Toronto Blue Jays beat the Boston Red Sox 5-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clement drives in tiebreaking run as Blue Jays beat Boston 5-3, hand Red Sox 4th straight loss

events.name: New York Mets at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Martín Pérez pitched six more scoreless innings, Ozzie Albies and Matt Olson homered, and the Atlanta Braves beat the New York Mets 4-0 Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pérez pitches 6 more scoreless innings, Albies and Olson homer for Braves in 4-0 win over Mets

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso, Gunnar Henderson and Christian Encarnacion-Strand each had three hits and a home run on Tuesday night as the Baltimore Orioles defeated the Minnesota Twins 5-2.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alonso, Henderson and Encarnacion-Strand homer for Orioles in 5-2 win over Twins

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz drove in automatic runner Matt McLain with a sacrifice fly in the top of the 10th inning as the Cincinnati Reds snapped a three-game skid with a 5-4 comeback win over the Chicago White Sox on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Reds rally late, beat the White Sox 5-4 in the 10th to spoil pope hat giveaway night

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Andre Pallante gave up four hits over six innings and Everson Pereira homered to help the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Philadelphia Phillies 2-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pallante silences the Phillies as Pereira’s homer lifts the Cardinals over Phillies 2-0

events.name: Texas Rangers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Zach Neto had an RBI single and scored during the Angels’ three-run third inning, and Los Angeles snapped its three-game skid with a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zach Neto keys early rally, Angels snap 3-game skid with 3-2 win over Rangers

headlines.description: — Kyle Karros hit a two-run homer before leaving the game following a collision with a teammate, Tomoyuki Sugano threw six solid innings and the Colorado Rockies rallied for a 3-2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Karros hits 2-run homer before leaving after collision, Rockies rally past Diamondbacks for 3-2 win

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Luis Rengifo hit a grand slam against the Brewers seven weeks after they released him, Fernando Tatis Jr. hit a milestone homer and the San Diego Padres beat Milwaukee 11-2 on Tuesday night to win a series against baseball's best team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luis Rengifo's grand slam against former team helps Padres to 11-2 win over Brewers

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Taylor Walls homered from both sides of the plate for the second time in his career, Nick Martinez tossed a complete game and the Tampa Bay Rays won their eighth straight game, 12-4 over the Athletics on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walls HRs from both sides of the plate for 2nd time in his career as Rays beat A's 12-4

events.name: Houston Astros at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Bryce Eldridge homered, fellow rookie Carson Whisenhunt pitched 5 2/3 innings after working out of two early bases-loaded jams and the San Francisco Giants beat the Houston Astros 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookies Bryce Eldridge and Carson Whisenhunt lead the Giants past the Astros, 4-1

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Max Muncy singled in Shohei Ohtani in the bottom of the 10th inning, lifting the Los Angeles Dodgers over the Kansas City Royals 5-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Muncy’s 10th-inning single lifts the Dodgers past the Royals 5-4
